item.title: Shoujo no Kimochi ~Onna no Ko Datte, Ecchi da mon!~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Ulala
  • 発売日: 2011-02-25
  • スコア: 5.92/10 (15 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 少女のきもち～おんなのこだって、エッチだもん！～
  • 英語名: Shoujo no Kimochi Onna no Ko Datte, Ecchi da mon!

あらすじ

The protagonist, a student at the private Kashoin Academy, is a recent transfer student.

While enjoying school life to a certain extent, he also begins to feel uneasy about being treated like a guest.

Then, the protagonist is forcefully appointed to the executive committee for the school festival’s signature event, the Miss School Festival Contest.

  • 英語名: Zettai Bishoujo Kaizou Club

あらすじ

The main character is good at inventing something odd. He is actually the boss of the science club, which is famous for the invention of strange creatures. He now secretly thinks, “I wanna adapt the girls!” He decides to call the adapted girls “Zettai Bishoujo”. There are three Bishoujo at school, Sayaka, Maria and Mana….
